display_title: HORIZON-CL5-2026-11-D3-06 Resource assessment for deep sedimentary and basement reservoirs – Horizon Europe
call_module_title: HORIZON-CL5-2026-11-D3-06 Resource assessment for deep sedimentary and basement reservoirs
executive_summary: A Horizon Europe Research and Innovation Action, funded as a lump sum, to develop methods, technologies and conceptual models that identify exploitable deep geothermal resources with low natural permeability at depths of 2,000 to 6,000 m, reaching TRL 4-5, including environmental and social impact assessment and community engagement. Standard Horizon Europe consortium rules apply (at least three independent legal entities from three Member States or Associated Countries). The topic budget is EUR 18 million for around four projects of about EUR 4.50 million each, funded at up to 100%. Single-stage; opened 4 August 2026, deadline 1 December 2026 at 17:00 Brussels time.
status_rationale: Climate, Energy and Mobility Work Programme 2026-2027 (Part 8), pp. 125–127, Specific conditions, Expected Outcome and Scope, funds research on subsurface exploration methods and reservoir models for deep geothermal resources. It does not touch TenneT's field: no project file is close to it, and the topic concerns geology, drilling risk and reservoir characterisation, with no link to electricity transmission, grid operation or markets.
